title: My sources
subtitle: Mailboxes, numbers and bots that send messages to your profiles. Only you see your sources.
info: A source is one of your connected accounts (a mailbox, a WhatsApp number or a Telegram bot). Each new batch of messages from it gets a quick check that decides which of your profiles should read it.
readsIt: Reads it = profiles the quick check may route to
footer: Turning a source off stops reading new messages; nothing is deleted. Removing it also deletes its routes.
emptyBody: Register a mailbox, WhatsApp number or Telegram bot so your profiles can read what arrives there.
meta.telegramOff: Telegram bot · Telegram triage is off
claimBannerBody: {claimant} tried to register {address}. It stays yours unless an admin moves it.
claimBannerAdmin: Someone tried to register an address another person already owns. Decide who keeps it.
claimsIntro: Each address belongs to one person. Keep it with its owner, or give it to the person who claimed it — their routes start fresh.
claimMine: {claimant} claimed {address}. It stays yours unless an admin moves it.
editIntro: Which of your profiles may get messages from {address}? The quick check picks among the ones that are on.
editHint: Turning a profile off stops new messages reaching it. Its existing to-dos stay. Profiles of other people never appear here.
removeBody: New messages stop reaching {profiles}. Existing to-dos and stored messages stay, and the account stays connected in Settings › In&Out.
routing.title: Recent routing
routing.subtitle: What the quick check decided for each batch from this source.
routing.info: Each new batch of messages gets one quick check. It picks which of your profiles should read it; batches no profile cares about are stored only and can still be searched. If the check fails, every routed profile gets the batch (Fallback).
routing.fallbackReason: The check failed {attempts} times, so all your routed profiles got it
routing.footer: Last {limit} decisions. Batches no profile cares about are stored and can still be searched.
routing.whyLabel: Why batch {id} was routed this way
routing.empty: No decisions yet. The first batch from this source shows up here after it is checked.
routing.unknownSource: This source is not one of yours, or it was removed.
wizard.title: Register a source
wizard.channelTitle: Where do the messages come from?
wizard.channelHint: Pick a channel, then one of your accounts on it.
wizard.connectHint.email: Opens the mailbox form. You come back here after.
wizard.connectHint.whatsapp: Opens WhatsApp pairing. You come back here after.
wizard.onlyYours: Only accounts you connected are shown. Each address belongs to one person.
wizard.telegramOff: Telegram triage is switched off. You can register {address} now; its messages are stored but no profile reads them until an admin turns Telegram triage on.
wizard.telegramOffShort: Telegram triage is switched off. Your bot keeps working as today; nothing is saved for triage until an admin turns on triage.agent.telegram in config.yaml.
wizard.profilesTitle: Which of your profiles should read it?
wizard.profilesHint: Pick one or more. Only your profiles are listed.
wizard.noProfilesBody: A source needs at least one of your profiles to read it. Ask an admin to add you to a profile, then come back. Your account stays connected.
wizard.accountsFailed.email: Couldn't check your mailboxes. This isn't the same as having none.
wizard.accountsFailed.whatsapp: Couldn't check your WhatsApp numbers. This isn't the same as having none.
wizard.accountsFailed.telegram: Couldn't check your Telegram bot. This isn't the same as having none.
wizard.accountsFailedHint: Hermes didn't answer just now. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, check Settings › In&Out.
wizard.noAccounts.email: You haven't connected a mailbox yet.
wizard.noAccounts.whatsapp: You haven't connected a WhatsApp number yet.
wizard.noAccounts.telegram: You haven't set up a Telegram bot yet.
wizard.askAdminHint: Tell an owner or admin of this Aquarium the account you sign in with, and ask them to add you to a profile (Users › Add to profile). Once they have, reload this page: your sources and connected accounts are still here.
suspendedBody: Sources can't be shown while you work in {profile}. Switch to one of your other profiles to see and register them.
wizard.triageHint: These decide what becomes a to-do or a Needs You item.
wizard.useTemplateHint: Recommended. You get template updates automatically.
wizard.keepMineHint: You already changed what {profile} cares about for {channel}. Your version is shared by all your {channel} sources; to go back to the template, reset it in Profile › My triage skills.
wizard.customizeHint: Start from the template and make your own version.
wizard.careHint: The quick check reads this to decide if {profile} should get a message. {count} / 2000
wizard.careTooLong: Too long: {bytes} / 4096 bytes. Chinese characters take 3 bytes each.
wizard.careLater: You can change the other triage files later in Profile › My triage skills.
wizard.reviewHint: Nothing is read until you register.
wizard.review.custom: {profile}: my version (What I care about edited)
wizard.review.telegramOff: Telegram triage is off — nothing saved
wizard.reviewNote: New messages start arriving within a few minutes. You can change routes or turn the source off any time.
wizard.conflict: {address} is already a source of another person. An address can have only one owner, so it wasn't added. We saved this as a claim; an admin can move it to you.
wizard.err.badRef: Hermes couldn't match this account. Close this window, reload the page and pick the account again.
wizard.err.notYours.email: This mailbox belongs to someone else, so you can't register it.
wizard.err.notYours.whatsapp: Only the person who added this WhatsApp bridge can register it. Ask them to, or connect your own number.
wizard.err.notYours.telegram: Only the person who saved this Telegram bot can register it. Ask them to, or set up your own bot.
wizard.err.missing.email: Hermes couldn't find this mailbox any more. Connect it again, then try again.
wizard.err.missing.whatsapp: This WhatsApp bridge no longer exists. Connect your number again, then try again.
wizard.err.missing.telegram: You have no Telegram bot saved yet. Set one up first, then try again.
wizard.err.notLinked: This WhatsApp bridge isn't linked to a phone yet. Scan the QR code with WhatsApp on your phone, then try again.
wizard.err.noToken: This Telegram bot has no working token saved. Paste the token from BotFather again, then try again.
wizard.err.profileBot: This is a profile's own Telegram bot, shared by everyone, so it can't be one person's source. Use your own bot instead.
wizard.partial: {address} is registered, but some steps did not finish: {detail}. Fix them from My sources.
wizard.conflictOwner: {address} is already a source of another person ({owner}). An address can have only one owner, so it wasn't added. We saved this as a claim; an admin can move it to you.
claimsLoadError: Could not load claims on your sources, so some may be missing here.
